item.title: Devlog 2 - Setting the Scene
item.description:
Above is a montage of some new scenes I’ve been working on. Not In-Game Footage — unlike GTA 6, this will be very close to the actual artwork (not a realistic or valid comparison, I know).

FYI I use Adobe Fresco , and I highly recommend it. It’s totally free and very easy to use. Randomly, I started this project with the graveyard scene. I was in Wales visiting family and started doodling in Fresco. I then realised I’d spent hours on it finger‑painting. So I bought an iPad Pro and a Pencil and started adding to it and creating more pieces.

item.title: Devlog 1 - What is A Beacon?
item.description:
A Beacon is a point-and-click adventure set in a dark medieval fantasy world, with humor — actual humor, not the odd giggle buried in 14 hours of fetch quests. I am heavily influenced by Monkey Island, Monty Python and early Blackadder comedy-stylings.

Build wise it is a solo project I’m working on using s&box engine and illustrating everything by hand in Adobe Fresco. It’s early days but yeah.

Here is a snippet of game play and some screen shots so far. I don’t want to give away too much so here’s a sneak-peak. More too come as and when 🪦
